landing.faq1a: We choose products that partner shops have in stock and that fit your price range, and rank them by quality for the price: the brand's reliability in this category, the product's specifications and how well it matches your answers. Up to three options across the price range: the best value overall, the best in the cheaper part and the best in the pricier part. We recommend a pricier option only if it is better than the cheaper ones. Shop commissions do not affect the order.
landing.faq2q: Are the prices up to date?
landing.faq2a: We update prices and availability several times a day from the shops' data feeds and match them by the EAN barcode. Discounts are shown only against the lowest price of the previous 30 days.
landing.faq3a: A refurbished product is the same model with the same EAN that, after a return, a demonstration or a repair, has been checked and is sold again, usually well below the price of a new one. For each we show the condition grade the shop states, the warranty and how much you save against the same model new. A product bought online, refurbished too, can usually be returned within 14 days. Refurbished products are always shown in a separate block, never among the new ones, and chosen by the same criteria as your choice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data Trilio processes, why, how long it is kept and what your rights are.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Trilio processes, why, how long we keep it and what your rights are. We process only what the service needs, and we do not sell data.
summary: Searching needs no account; your answers are kept without your name or e-mail.
Statistics cookies (Google Analytics) are set only if you allow them. Trilio's own visit counts use no cookies.
You can download all your data and delete your account yourself on the Account page.

p: The controller of personal data is {company}, registration No. {regNo}, legal address: {address}. Send questions about data to {email}.

items: Searching without an account: answers to the questions (category, budget, requirements) are kept without a name or e-mail, to show results and understand demand. Basis: legitimate interests.
Clicks on shop links: we record which offer was opened and when, without your identity, to account for partner commissions. Basis: legitimate interests.
Account: e-mail address. If you sign in with Google, also the name, profile picture link and access tokens issued by Google. Basis: performance of a contract.

Wishlist: the products and searches you save and notification settings (whether price e-mails are on). For browser notifications we keep the subscription address and keys issued by the browser. Basis: performance of a contract; by saving a product you ask to be told when its price drops.

Subscription and payments: plan, status, payment amounts and dates and a payment token issued by Paysera, kept encrypted. Card data is processed only by Paysera; Trilio never sees or stores it. Basis: performance of a contract and a legal obligation.

Waiting list: if you leave an e-mail under “Something else”, we keep the e-mail and the request text to tell you when the category is available. Basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
Technical logs: the hosting service briefly records IP addresses and requests for security and fixing errors. Basis: legitimate interests.

Usage statistics: only if you allow it in the cookie window, Google Analytics records the pages and sections visited and the buttons pressed, as well as the device and browser type and approximate location (country, city). Your typed text, answers and e-mail are not there. Basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time with the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page.

Visit statistics without cookies: Trilio counts page views itself. From the IP address, the browser and a random value that changes every day we make an anonymous code that cannot be linked to you or to other days; the IP address itself is not stored. Basis: legitimate interests.

Arriving from an ad: if you arrive by clicking an ad, we record the ad click identifier (gclid) and the campaign name with that day's visit code (without cookies, as for visit statistics), to count how many shop clicks and saves each ad brought. Basis: legitimate interests.

Personal offers: if you allow it, we e-mail offers for products you saved. We keep the consent, the offers sent and whether the offer page was opened (the e-mails have no tracking). Basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time with the link in the e-mail or in the wishlist.

Purchases from Trilio: name, phone, delivery address or parcel locker, company details (if buying for a company), payment status, parcel number and invoices. Basis: performance of a contract and a legal obligation (accounting).

p: If you describe what you are looking for under “Something else”, the text may be sent to Anthropic's Claude model to find the product category. The log keeps only the time and size of the request, not the text. Please don't write personal data there.
The order of products and the prices are calculated by ordinary code, not by artificial intelligence.
Data is processed only by these service providers and only as far as their task requires:
items: Railway: server and database hosting.
Cloudflare: domain name system (DNS).
Google: signing in with a Google account, if you choose it.
Google Ireland Limited: usage statistics (Google Analytics), only with your consent.
Google Ireland Limited: Google Ads measurement (which ad brought a visitor), only with your consent. Ads are not personalised.
Resend: sending e-mails (EU region).
Paysera LT, UAB: payment processing.
Anthropic: finding the category from free text, as described above.
Browser notification services (for example Google, Mozilla, Apple): delivering browser notifications, if you switch them on.
Couriers (Omniva, DPD, Venipak, Latvijas Pasts): name, phone and delivery address, to deliver a product you bought.
after: Partner shops receive only what you send them yourself by opening their page. We do not pass on your e-mail or search history.

p: Some service providers (Railway, Cloudflare, Google, Resend, Anthropic) are US companies. We transfer data to them on the basis of the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

items: Account data and wishlist: while the account is active. A removed product or search is deleted at once.

Deleting the account is final: we delete the account, the wishlist, the subscription and payment records in Trilio's system. Accounting documents for payments made are kept by Paysera and our accountant for the period required by law (5 years).
Waiting list: until the category launches, but no longer than 12 months.
Usage statistics in Google Analytics: 14 months.
Search answers and click statistics: without an account they are not linked to you, and we use them for statistics.
Sign-in links in e-mails: 15 minutes.
Visit statistics: raw records 35 days, then only totals per day and page.
Arriving from an ad: 90 days, then only totals per day and campaign.
Purchases and invoices: invoices are kept for the period required by law (5 years), also after the account is deleted; when the account is deleted, the phone number and delivery notes are erased.

p: You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict its processing, object to processing, receive it in a portable format and withdraw consent at any time.
On the Account page you can download all your data and delete the account yourself. Send other requests to {email}, and we'll answer within a month.
If you believe your data has been processed unlawfully, you can complain to the Data State Inspectorate (www.dvi.gov.lv).

Cookies the service needs are always used. Google Analytics statistics and Google Ads measurement cookies are set only with your permission, and we do not use them to personalise ads. More in the cookie policy.
The service is not intended for children under 13.
We'll e-mail account holders about significant changes to this policy.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Terms of the Trilio service, the wishlist and price e-mails.
terms.intro: These terms apply to the use of {site}, the wishlist and price e-mails. Please read them before creating an account.
summary: Trilio helps you choose; you buy from the shop, under the shop's terms. Personal offers are the exception: there Trilio is the seller.
Shop commissions never affect the order of products.
The wishlist and price e-mails are free; you can turn the e-mails off with one click.

p: The service is provided by {company}, registration No. {regNo}, legal address: {address}, e-mail: {email}.
Trilio helps you choose home appliances: we ask a few questions and show the most suitable offers from partner shops.

Trilio does not sell products itself: you make the purchase contract with the shop, and the shop's terms, prices, delivery, warranty and right of withdrawal apply. The exception is personal offers we send to those who allowed it: there the seller is Trilio, and the Purchase terms (/pirkuma-noteikumi) apply.

Prices, stock and delivery times come from the shops' data and are updated several times a day, but they may change sooner in the shop. The price on the shop's page at the time of purchase is decisive.
Discounts are compared with the lowest price of the previous 30 days.
Some links to shops are partner links. If you buy a product after following one, the shop may pay us a commission. It costs you nothing.
The commission does not affect the order of products. The order depends only on your answers, the price and the product's properties, as described in “How do we choose and rank?”.
The second source of income is personal offers: products Trilio sells itself to people who have allowed it.
An account is needed for the wishlist and price e-mails. You are responsible for the security of your e-mail or Google account. You can delete the account at any time on the Account page.

items: The wishlist and price e-mails are free.
By saving a product or a search you ask us to tell you when its price drops. We write at most once a day and only about price drops, with no advertising.
You can turn the e-mails off at any time: with “Don't send” under the saved product, in the wishlist, on the Account page or with the link at the end of every e-mail.
We send personal offers from Trilio only if you allow them separately. That is a different consent and can be withdrawn the same way.

p: Trilio's services are free, so there is nothing to refund for them.
Products Trilio sells in personal offers come with a 14-day right of withdrawal, as described in the Purchase terms.
Don't use Trilio for automated data collection, to disrupt the service or for unlawful purposes. In case of a breach we may restrict access.
We collect the information carefully but do not guarantee that it is always complete and current. We are not responsible for the shops' products, delivery or services.
Our liability to you is limited as far as the law allows. These terms do not limit your consumer rights.
We settle disputes by negotiation; write to {email}.
A consumer can also turn to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre (www.ptac.gov.lv), including its Consumer Dispute Resolution Commission. The laws of the Republic of Latvia apply.
We'll e-mail account holders about significant changes at least 30 days in advance.

cookies.description: Which cookies Trilio uses and why.
cookies.intro: Trilio always uses only the cookies the service cannot work without. Google Analytics statistics cookies and Google Ads measurement cookies are set only if you allow it in the cookie window. They measure which ad brought you here; we do not use them to personalise ads (remarketing).

p: On trilio.lv these cookie names are prefixed with “__Secure-” or “__Host-”. This means they are sent only over an encrypted connection.
If you switch browser notifications on, the browser registers a Trilio service worker. It is not a cookie. You can switch notifications off on the wishlist page or in the browser settings.
When you open a shop's page, the shop's cookie policy applies.

You can change your choice about statistics and ad measurement cookies at any time with the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page. If you withdraw permission, the Google Analytics and Google Ads cookies are deleted.
You can also delete or block cookies in the browser settings. If you delete the sign-in cookie, you will need to sign in again.

purchase.title: Purchase terms
purchase.description: Terms for products Trilio sells itself in personal offers: price, delivery, right of withdrawal, warranty for private persons and companies.
purchase.intro: These terms apply to products that {company} sells itself when you accept a personal offer on {site}. Products from partner shops are covered by the shops' terms.
summary: Delivery in Latvia is always free.
Private buyers can withdraw within 14 days of receiving the product, without a reason, and the return is free.
Private buyers get the 2-year legal guarantee; warranty claims go to Trilio.
Companies get an invoice to the company; the 14-day withdrawal does not apply to them.

p: The seller is {company}, registration No. {regNo}, legal address: {address}, e-mail: {email}. The invoice is issued by the seller.

items: We send personal offers only to those who allowed it. An offer is valid until the date stated in it or until the product's stock runs out.
The contract is concluded when the order is paid. We send the confirmation and the invoice to the account's e-mail.
Prices are in euros. If the seller is VAT-registered, VAT is included in the price; otherwise VAT does not apply.
The saving is compared with the lowest price in partner shops over the previous 30 days and is stated only if our price is lower.

p: Payments are processed by Paysera LT, UAB: payment card, bank link, Apple Pay or Google Pay, where available. Trilio never sees or stores card details.

items: Delivery in Latvia is always free.
Large appliances are delivered by courier to the door; if carrying in is needed, say so in the order. Smaller appliances can also be collected from an Omniva parcel locker.
The delivery time is stated in working days before payment. The courier calls before delivery. You can see the parcel status and the tracking link under “My orders”.
Check the packaging when you receive the product. If it is damaged, note it on the courier's document and write to us.
You have the right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of the day you receive the product, without giving a reason.
You can withdraw with the “Withdraw from the purchase” button on the order page or by writing to {email}.
The return within Latvia is free: we arrange the courier. Return the product within 14 days of withdrawing.
We refund the money within 14 days of receiving the withdrawal at the latest, but may hold it until we receive the product back. We refund using the same payment method.
You are liable for a reduction in the product's value if you used it more than needed to establish its nature, characteristics and functioning.

p: The product has the 2-year legal guarantee against non-conformity with the contract. If the offer states a longer manufacturer's warranty, it applies in addition. Send claims to {email}: we handle them, not the distributor.

items: The invoice is made out to the company with the details you enter in the order.
The 14-day consumer right of withdrawal does not apply to companies.
The warranty is the manufacturer's warranty stated in the offer. Send claims to {email}: we handle them.
The seller's liability for indirect losses is excluded as far as the law allows.

p: For a refurbished product we state the condition grade, the warranty and the saving against new. Before paying you confirm that you know the product's condition. New and refurbished products are never mixed.

If there is a problem, first write to {email}, and we'll answer within one working day. A private person can also turn to the Consumer Rights Protection Centre (www.ptac.gov.lv) or the EU dispute resolution platform. Latvian law applies to the contract.

consent.title: Cookies for statistics and ad measurement
consent.text: Do you allow Google Analytics and Google Ads measurement cookies? They help us see which sections and buttons are used and which ads bring visitors, so we can improve Trilio. Ads are not personalised for you. Without your permission the cookies are not loaded, and the site works the same. More: <policy>cookie policy</policy>.
